responses:
**Don't send the offer as it stands.** Three of the analysis's four items are wrong, and two of those make the offer non-compliant. Several requirements aren't checked at all.

## Item by item

| # | Analysis says | Tender actually says | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | IE3 required; IE3 on all motors including P-01 (90 kW) complies | 4.2 sets IE3 as the minimum, but **9.1** says motors above 75 kW must be **IE4**, and **9.3** says Section 9 wins over Section 4 | ❌ **Wrong.** P-01 (90 kW) needs IE4, so the offer is **non-compliant**. P-02 (37 kW) at IE3 is fine. |
| 2 | ATEX not required | 4.3 requires ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1. Annex B lists the **Wet well as Zone 1**, and P-01 is in the wet well | ❌ **Wrong.** P-01's motor needs **ATEX Ex d**. P-02 in the valve chamber (non-hazardous) doesn't. |
| 3 | 400 V / 60 Hz | 4.1: 400 V, 3-phase, **50 Hz** | ❌ **Wrong frequency.** Also check the offer itself: a motor or panel built for 60 Hz won't do. |
| 4 | IP65 required; IP66 offered, complies | 4.5: panels and motor terminal enclosures IP65 or better | ✅ Correct, provided IP66 covers both the panels and the motor terminal boxes. |

## Requirements the analysis leaves out

- **4.4 Cables:** minimum conductor size 2.5 mm². Not checked.
- **7.1 Warranty:** 24 months from **commissioning**, not from delivery. Check the offer's warranty wording.
- **7.4 Delivery:** within 16 weeks of the purchase order, and **offers over 16 weeks will be rejected**. This is a pass/fail condition, so confirm the lead time. An IE4 Ex d 90 kW motor may take longer to deliver than a standard IE3 one.
- **9.2 Ambient 50 °C:** standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C. Check whether motor or panel derating is needed and that the ratings still hold at 50 °C.
- **9.3 Precedence:** the analysis ignores it, and that's why item 1 went wrong.

## Other notes

- Section 7 jumps from 7.1 to 7.4. Confirm you have the full tender and aren't missing clauses 7.2 and 7.3.
- The analysis doesn't cite clause numbers. Citing them for each item would have caught the 9.1 override and the Annex B link.

## Changes needed before sending

1. Change the P-01 motor to **IE4 and ATEX Ex d**.
2. Fix the supply to **50 Hz** in the analysis, and in the offer if it was carried over.
3. Confirm cable sizes, warranty start date, delivery of 16 weeks or less (including the changed P-01 motor), and derating for 50 °C ambient.

I haven't edited `agent_analysis.md`. I can rewrite it with clause references and these corrections if you'd like.
